# MCP reference

`forge-mcp` speaks the Model Context Protocol over stdio. The tool list is the command registry plus the tools below. Command tools take the arguments of the [command](commands.md) with the same name (`.` becomes `_`). Tools that need a viewport (`viewport_screenshot`) work only against a running editor.

## Built-in tools

### `scene_get`

The whole scene: frame range, selection and the node tree with parameters in user units.

No arguments.

### `node_get`

One node: type, parameters, tags, children.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | integer | yes | node id |

### `eval_mesh_summary`

Evaluate a node's mesh (animation and deformers applied, world space) and return only the point and polygon counts and the bounding box.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `node` | integer | yes | node id |
| `frame` | integer | no | frame; default the current one |

### `viewport_screenshot`

Render the editor's viewport (current camera, shading and frame) and return it as a PNG image. Needs the editor window's machine to have a GPU; headless servers report an error.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `height` | integer | no | pixels, default 600 |
| `width` | integer | no | pixels, default 800 |

### `export_obj`

Write the scene evaluated at the current frame as a Wavefront OBJ file (alias of file_export_obj).

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes | output file |
| `selected` | array of integer | no | only these nodes and their descendants |

### `frame_set`

Move the timeline to a frame, clamped to the project range (alias of timeline_set_frame).

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `frame` | integer | yes |  |

## Command tools

| Tool | Description |
|---|---|
| `object_create` | Create. Undoable editing command. Runs command `object.create`. |
| `object_delete` | Delete. Undoable editing command. Runs command `object.delete`. |
| `object_rename` | Rename. Undoable editing command. Runs command `object.rename`. |
| `object_reparent` | Move. Undoable editing command. Runs command `object.reparent`. |
| `edit_undo` | Undo. Not an undoable edit. Runs command `edit.undo`. |
| `edit_redo` | Redo. Not an undoable edit. Runs command `edit.redo`. |
| `view_shading` | Shading. Not an undoable edit. Runs command `view.shading`. |
| `view_frame_all` | Frame All. Not an undoable edit. Runs command `view.frame_all`. |
| `view_toggle_expanded` | Expand / Collapse. Not an undoable edit. Runs command `view.toggle_expanded`. |
| `select_mode` | Selection Mode. Not an undoable edit. Runs command `select.mode`. |
| `select_all` | Select All. Undoable editing command. Runs command `select.all`. |
| `select_none` | Deselect All. Undoable editing command. Runs command `select.none`. |
| `select_invert` | Invert Selection. Undoable editing command. Runs command `select.invert`. |
| `select_grow` | Grow Selection. Undoable editing command. Runs command `select.grow`. |
| `select_shrink` | Shrink Selection. Undoable editing command. Runs command `select.shrink`. |
| `transform_set` | Set Transform. Undoable editing command. Runs command `transform.set`. |
| `mesh_make_editable` | Make Editable. Undoable editing command. Runs command `mesh.make_editable`. |
| `mesh_current_state_to_object` | Current State to Object. Undoable editing command. Runs command `mesh.current_state_to_object`. |
| `param_set` | Set Parameter. Undoable editing command. Runs command `param.set`. |
| `key_record` | Record. Undoable editing command. Runs command `key.record`. |
| `key_delete_at_frame` | Delete Keys. Undoable editing command. Runs command `key.delete_at_frame`. |
| `key_jump` | Jump to Key. Not an undoable edit. Runs command `key.jump`. |
| `key_set` | Set Key. Undoable editing command. Runs command `key.set`. |
| `key_autokey` | Autokey. Not an undoable edit. Runs command `key.autokey`. |

| `file_open` | Open. Not an undoable edit. Runs command `file.open`. |
| `file_save` | Save. Not an undoable edit. Runs command `file.save`. |
| `file_save_as` | Save As. Not an undoable edit. Runs command `file.save_as`. |
| `file_import_obj` | Import OBJ. Undoable editing command. Runs command `file.import_obj`. |
| `file_export_obj` | Export OBJ. Not an undoable edit. Runs command `file.export_obj`. |
